arguments.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 - << 'EOF'
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/project')
from modules.byte_program import literal, concat, repeat, cut, fingerprint, size, materialize, next_lf, Context

ctx = Context([['unit', "b'abc\\r\\n'"]], 's')
big = repeat(ctx.env['unit'], (1 << 60))
assert size(big) == 5 * (1 << 60) <= (1 << 63) - 1
assert fingerprint(big)['n'] == 5 * (1 << 60)
small = repeat(literal(b'abc\r\n'), 3)
assert fingerprint(small) == fingerprint(literal(b'abc\r\n' * 3))
sub = cut(big, (1 << 60) * 3 - 2, (1 << 60) * 3 + 8)
exp = (b'abc\r\n' * 4)[1:11]
assert sub.window(0, sub.n) == exp, (sub.window(0, sub.n), exp)
assert fingerprint(sub) == fingerprint(literal(exp))
assert next_lf(big, 0) == 4
assert next_lf(big, 5) == 9
assert next_lf(literal(b'abc'), 0) == -1
assert materialize(cut(big, 0, 5)) == b'abc\r\n'
n2 = cut(concat(repeat(literal(b'xy'), 1 << 40), literal(b'z')), (1 << 40) - 1, (1 << 40) + 2)
assert fingerprint(n2) == fingerprint(literal(b'yxy')), fingerprint(n2)
print('compressed ops OK')

try:
    Context([['n', '5']], 's')
    print('int def accepted (policy b)')
except ValueError:
    print('int def rejected (policy a)')
EOF
